rules.name: Formation
rules.description: CARCASS faction trait. Gain +1D on attacks if adjacent to an allied unit.

rules.name: Headshot
rules.description: CARCASS special tag. Effect that triggers when rolling a 6 on the final attack roll.

rules.name: Reload
rules.description: CARCASS faction tag. This ability must be reloaded by sacrificing a MOVE before becoming usable again. Reloading refreshes all abilities with reload.
